provenance.construction: Twisted-torus bivariate-bicycle code from Generalized toric codes on twisted tori for quantum error correction (PRX Quantum 6, 020357, 2025). Stabilizers f(x,y)=1+x+xy, g(x,y)=1+y+xy on the abelian quotient group Z^2/L with twist basis a_1=[0, 3], a_2=[2, 1] (n=2|det[a_1,a_2]|=2*6). Reconstructed from the published polynomials and twist; CSS form H_X=[f|g], H_Z=[gbar|fbar].
provenance.notes: Reconstructed baseline from Liang, Liu, Song, Chen, Generalized toric codes on twisted tori for quantum error correction (PRX Quantum 6, 020357, 2025), arXiv:2503.03827. The [[n,k,d]] parameter set and stabilizer polynomials are published in that paper; this entry reproduces them. Distance is an upper bound per the paper (probabilistic for d>20); the witness is the surrogate logical of that weight. Seeded to fill a board coverage gap at this block size, not a discovery. 2D-local layout added 2026-07-27: simulated annealing over qubit-to-site assignments on a unit-spaced triangular grid (1 layer, capacity 1 per site per layer); measured interaction radius 2.645751 (single-layer); same code, same check matrices.

circuit.notes: Interleaved two-block extraction (Bravyi et al. arXiv:2308.07915 Table 5 style): joint reset and measurement layers, 7 data CX layers per round; X-check term slots [3, 4, 2, 5, 6, 1], Z-check term slots [4, 3, 2, 0, 1, 5] over terms A_0..A_2, B_0..B_2; terms recovered from H alone by a commuting permutation decomposition. Order screened by RIS among the 1968 slot assignments satisfying the overlap-parity criterion (second one tried); the claim then survived 3 seeds x 1500 RIS trials per basis and an observable-constrained seeded BP+OSD search over symmetric seeds, whose lightest undetected logical fault set is weight 2 in both bases.
